heading: About ITROAD Group
text:
About ITROAD Group
ITROAD Group builds technology that moves enterprises forward. Since 2009, ITROAD Group has been a trusted partner for digital transformation across the Middle East and Africa.

heading: Our mission
text:
Our mission
To empower organizations with innovative technology solutions that create lasting value, drive efficiency, and unlock new possibilities for growth.

heading: Our vision
text:
Our vision
To be the region's most trusted digital transformation partner, recognized for technical excellence, innovation, and the measurable impact we create for every client.

heading: Company track record
text:
Company track record
ITROAD Group has 15+ years of expertise, has delivered 250+ projects, works with 60+ enterprise clients, and has a 98% client retention rate.

heading: Company history
text:
Company history
ITROAD Group was founded in 2009 with a vision for enterprise digital transformation. In 2013 it expanded regionally, opening offices across North Africa and the Middle East. In 2017 it launched dedicated cloud and artificial intelligence practices. In 2020 it achieved top-tier partnerships with Microsoft, AWS, and Google Cloud. By 2024 it had surpassed 250 enterprise projects delivered across 6 industries.

heading: Our values
text:
Our values
ITROAD Group is guided by four values: Integrity (building trust through transparency and accountability), Innovation (pushing boundaries and embracing emerging technologies), Client-Centric approach (the client's success defines ours, every decision starts with the client), and Excellence (holding ourselves to the highest standards in everything we deliver).

heading: Leadership
text:
Leadership
ITROAD Group's leadership team includes Youssef El Amrani (CEO & Founder), Leila Ben Salah (CTO), Omar Khelifi (VP of Delivery), and Nadia Trabelsi (VP of Sales).

heading: Recognition
text:
Recognition
ITROAD Group's work has been recognized by leading industry bodies and partners, including Microsoft Gold Partner status, AWS Advanced Consulting Partner status, ISO 27001 certification, and a Top Employer 2025 distinction.

heading: Careers at ITROAD Group
text:
Careers at ITROAD Group
ITROAD Group offers career growth with mentorship and certifications, comprehensive health coverage and flexible work arrangements, an annual learning budget with access to top-tier courses, and meaningful work on projects that impact millions of users across industries. Open roles include Senior Cloud Architect (Remote), AI/ML Engineer (Tunis), Full-Stack Developer (Remote), DevOps Engineer (Dubai), Security Consultant (Tunis, contract), and Product Designer (Remote).

heading: FAQ Services
text:
FAQ Services
Comment fixez-vous le prix des projets ? ITROAD Group propose des modèles à prix fixe, en régie (temps et matériel), ou en équipe dédiée, et recommande le meilleur format après un appel de découverte. Quelle est votre durée typique ? La plupart des projets d'entreprise durent 3 à 9 mois ; une feuille de route détaillée est fournie après le cadrage. Proposez-vous un support continu ? Oui, ITROAD Group propose des services gérés, des SLA et un support 24/7 pour toutes les solutions livrées. Pouvez-vous travailler avec notre équipe existante ? Oui, ITROAD Group s'intègre aux équipes internes et peut renforcer les effectifs selon les besoins.
